correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<q<1 reconstructed the monic discrete q-Hermite I recurrence, exact finite coefficient sum (DLMF 18.27.21), and the error h_n(x)=x^n(x^{-2};q^2)_infinity+O_q(rho^n) uniformly with two derivatives for x near 1. On a compact interior the polynomials decay exponentially; endpoint product has a simple zero with slope -2C_q. Squaring and summing yields E_N(x)=x^{2N+2}G_q(x)+O(rho^N), G_q(x)=2C_q^4(1-x)+O((1-x)^2). The N(1-x)=s layer has limiting N E_N=2C_q^4s exp(-2s), maximizing uniquely at s=1/2 and value C_q^4/e. Gram Cauchy-Schwarz transfers diagonal to full square; strict concavity on the maximizing layer and parity give exactly two diagonal maxima and 1-|x|=1/(2N)+O(N^-2). Independently calculated n|h_n(1-1/n)| at q=1/2 for n=30,90,180 as 0.508688,0.507425,0.507027 toward 2C_q/e=0.506598. The numerical sequence is a check, not proof.
